scope: Private diagnostic overlay; no product behavior change or acceptance claim. Native run pending quiet gate completion.
review: Route/body markers contain only IDs, byte counts and booleans.
Frame work is wall elapsed time from max(signal_at, dirty_at) to present_start.
Pre-draw, draw and post-draw timestamps permit residual attribution; no CPU-sampling claim.
Foreground journal adds input dispatch intervals and discontinuity markers.
Overlay does not disable report selection, Markdown or animations.
limitations: Instrumentation adds overhead; compare phase attribution and recheck any eventual product repair without this overlay.
Journal present records omit associated frame fields; use frames.jsonl for complete paired draw/present boundaries.
